name: data_profile
description:
Profiles a local CSV, JSON, or JSONL data file without modifying it. Returns inferred columns, data types, null counts, duplicate-row count, bounded sample rows, and simple PII category counts.
Use when: understanding a dataset before writing a query or transformation.
Scope: local filesystem only. Read-only; profiles at most 10,000 rows.
Not for: full-scale analytics, modifying data, or sending data to a remote model.

sample_rows.description: Rows to return as a sample. Default: 5. Max: 20.
